name: Comic Con India (Delhi)
blurb: Delhi leg of Comic Con India's national pop-culture tour, run with ReedPop, with comics-industry guests, cosplay and an artist program.

editions.evidence: Page text: '5th - 6th Dec 2026 NSIC Exhibition Grounds, Delhi'

notes: Single-page site (comicconindia.com/all-cities-pages-2026/delhi-comic-con); guests and dates are on the same page, not a separate guest URL. Only one guest (Ant Williams) is revealed so far; the page itself says 'More Updates Coming Soon' for the rest of the lineup. No edition-specific key art is published yet (no og/twitter image, no banner), so the cover uses the Comic Con India logo from the main homepage (pipeline/cache/extract/comic-con-india-hub.home.json), shared across all Comic Con India city files in this batch. No distinct ticket URL could be captured (the BOOK PASSES button is JS-driven, not a plain link).
